script_text: Taurus, this week is not gentle; it is a money-and-love pressure test from your Earth element and ruling planet Venus. Monday through Wednesday, retrograde Mercury in your 2nd House squares Neptune, so reread contracts, invoices, and payment apps before trusting a promise. Tuesday’s Venus sextile Mars in Aries and your 12th House brings romantic chemistry, but keep it private. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury stations direct in your 2nd House, clearing a financial bottleneck. Thursday’s Sun trine Saturn in Pisces and your 11th House opens career support from a mentor, friend, or group contact. Friday through Sunday, Venus in your 3rd House trines Jupiter in Cancer, making texts, dates, and short trips sweeter; however, Mars square Pluto warns against jealousy. Best day: Wednesday. Worst day: Monday. Protect your bank account first. Follow for daily updates.
